title: File Sync

functional: Upload and download files and folders across devices.
Propagate changes to other online devices within seconds.
Support offline edits and reconnect without data loss.
Keep file versions and allow restoring an earlier version.
Resolve concurrent edits with a predictable conflict policy.
nonFunctional: Acknowledged uploads must be durable and never silently lost.
Metadata operations should stay fast even for large folders.
Deduplicate identical content to control storage growth.
Reconnect and catch up efficiently after a long offline period.
The system must tolerate partial uploads, retries, and device crashes.

checklist: Upload commit protocol and durability boundary
Delta sync, cursors, and offline catch-up
followUps: How would you support shared folders with per-user permissions?
How would you sync a 100 GB file without blocking the UI?
How would you detect and repair a corrupted block?
What changes if devices can be offline for months?
commonMistakes: Treating a successful block upload as a committed file.
Letting two devices overwrite the same version without detecting the conflict.
Pushing every change to every device instead of using a cursor.
Deduplicating only by file name or path.
Forgetting garbage collection for orphaned blocks and old versions.
